passages.text: Now this is what the LORD says— He who created you, O Jacob, and He who formed you, O Israel: “Do not fear, for I have redeemed you; I have called you by your name; you are Mine!
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks now.
The LORD created you, Jacob.
The LORD formed you, Israel.
Do not be afraid.
I have redeemed you.
I have called you by your name.
You belong to Me.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֞ה כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ בֹּרַאֲךָ֣ יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְיֹצֶרְךָ֖ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אַל־ תִּירָא֙ כִּ֣י גְאַלְתִּ֔יךָ קָרָ֥אתִי בְשִׁמְךָ֖ לִי־ אָֽתָּה׃

passages.text: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and when you go through the rivers, they will not overwhelm you. When you walk through the fire, you will not be scorched; the flames will not set you ablaze.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to Israel.
The LORD is the Creator of Israel.
The LORD is with Israel.
When you pass through deep waters, I am with you.
When you go through rivers, the rivers will not sweep over you.
When you walk through fire, you will not be burned.
The flames will not consume you.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ תַעֲבֹ֤ר בַּמַּ֙יִם֙ אִתְּךָ־ אָ֔נִי וּבַנְּהָר֖וֹת לֹ֣א יִשְׁטְפ֑וּךָ כִּֽי־ תֵלֵ֤ךְ בְּמוֹ־ אֵשׁ֙ לֹ֣א תִכָּוֶ֔ה וְלֶהָבָ֖ה לֹ֥א תִבְעַר־ בָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: For I am the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior; I give Egypt for your ransom, Cush and Seba in your place.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to Israel.
The LORD is your God.
The LORD is holy.
The LORD is the Holy One of Israel.
The LORD is your Savior.
The LORD gave Egypt as a ransom for you.
The LORD gave Cush and Seba in your place.
passages.original: כִּ֗י אֲנִי֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ קְד֥וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מוֹשִׁיעֶ֑ךָ נָתַ֤תִּי כָפְרְךָ֙ מִצְרַ֔יִם כּ֥וּשׁ וּסְבָ֖א תַּחְתֶּֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Because you are precious and honored in My sight, and because I love you, I will give men in exchange for you and nations in place of your life.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people Israel.
God sees Israel as precious.
God honors Israel.
God loves Israel.
God will give other people in exchange for Israel.
God will give nations in place of Israel’s life.
passages.original: מֵאֲשֶׁ֨ר יָקַ֧רְתָּ בְעֵינַ֛י נִכְבַּ֖דְתָּ וַאֲנִ֣י אֲהַבְתִּ֑יךָ וְאֶתֵּ֤ן אָדָם֙ תַּחְתֶּ֔יךָ וּלְאֻמִּ֖ים תַּ֥חַת נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃

passages.text: Do not be afraid, for I am with you; I will bring your offspring from the east and gather you from the west.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people Israel.
God is holy.
God is their Savior.
God says, “Do not be afraid.”
God is with them.
God will bring their children from the east.
God will gather them from the west.
passages.original: אַל־ תִּירָ֖א כִּ֣י אִתְּךָ־ אָ֑נִי מִמִּזְרָח֙ אָבִ֣יא זַרְעֶ֔ךָ וּמִֽמַּעֲרָ֖ב אֲקַבְּצֶֽךָּ׃

passages.text: I will say to the north, ‘Give them up!’ and to the south, ‘Do not hold them back!’ Bring My sons from afar, and My daughters from the ends of the earth— everyone called by My name and created for My glory, whom I have indeed formed and made.”
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people Israel.
God says to the north, “Release them.”
God says to the south, “Do not hold them back.”
God commands, “Bring My sons from far away.”
God commands, “Bring My daughters from the ends of the earth.”
God refers to everyone called by His name.
God created these people for His glory.
God formed them.
God made them.
passages.original: אֹמַ֤ר לַצָּפוֹן֙ תֵּ֔נִי וּלְתֵימָ֖ן אַל־ תִּכְלָ֑אִי הָבִ֤יאִי בָנַי֙ מֵרָח֔וֹק וּבְנוֹתַ֖י מִקְצֵ֥ה הָאָֽרֶץ׃ כֹּ֚ל הַנִּקְרָ֣א בִשְׁמִ֔י וְלִכְבוֹדִ֖י בְּרָאתִ֑יו יְצַרְתִּ֖יו אַף־ עֲשִׂיתִֽיו׃

passages.text: Bring out a people who have eyes but are blind, and who have ears but are deaf.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people Israel.
God commands someone to bring out a group of people.
These people have eyes.
These people cannot see.
These people have ears.
These people cannot hear.
passages.original: הוֹצִ֥יא עַם־ עִוֵּ֖ר וְעֵינַ֣יִם יֵ֑שׁ וְחֵרְשִׁ֖ים וְאָזְנַ֥יִם לָֽמוֹ׃

passages.text: All the nations gather together and the peoples assemble. Who among them can declare this, and proclaim to us the former things? Let them present their witnesses to vindicate them, so that others may hear and say, “It is true.”
passages.sermon:
All the nations come together.
All the peoples gather in one place.
God asks a question.
He says, "Who among them can tell us these things?"
He asks, "Who can make known to us what happened before?"
God tells them to bring their witnesses.
He says, "Let them prove themselves right."
He wants others to listen.
He wants others to say, 'It is true.'
passages.original: כָּֽל־ הַגּוֹיִ֞ם נִקְבְּצ֣וּ יַחְדָּ֗ו וְיֵאָֽסְפוּ֙ לְאֻמִּ֔ים מִ֤י בָהֶם֙ יַגִּ֣יד זֹ֔את וְרִֽאשֹׁנ֖וֹת יַשְׁמִיעֻ֑נוּ יִתְּנ֤וּ עֵֽדֵיהֶם֙ וְיִצְדָּ֔קוּ וְיִשְׁמְע֖וּ וְיֹאמְר֥וּ אֱמֶֽת׃

passages.text: “You are My witnesses,” declares the LORD, “and My servant whom I have chosen, so that you may consider and believe Me and understand that I am He. Before Me no god was formed, and after Me none will come.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD says, "You are My witnesses."
I have chosen you as My servant.
I chose you so you will know Me.
I chose you so you will believe Me.
I chose you so you will understand that I am He.
No god existed before Me.
No god will exist after Me.
passages.original: אַתֶּ֤ם עֵדַי֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְעַבְדִּ֖י אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּחָ֑רְתִּי לְמַ֣עַן תֵּ֠דְעוּ וְתַאֲמִ֨ינוּ לִ֤י וְתָבִ֙ינוּ֙ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י ה֔וּא לְפָנַי֙ לֹא־ נ֣וֹצַר אֵ֔ל וְאַחֲרַ֖י לֹ֥א יִהְיֶֽה׃ס

passages.text: I, yes I, am the LORD, and there is no Savior but Me.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD is the one true God.
The LORD alone saves.
No one else can save except the LORD.
passages.original: אָנֹכִ֥י אָנֹכִ֖י יְהוָ֑ה וְאֵ֥ין מִבַּלְעָדַ֖י מוֹשִֽׁיעַ׃

passages.text: I alone decreed and saved and proclaimed— I, and not some foreign god among you. So you are My witnesses,” declares the LORD, “that I am God.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to His people Israel.
The LORD is God.
The LORD alone made these things known.
The LORD alone saved His people.
The LORD alone announced what would happen.
No foreign god was among the people.
The LORD says, “You are My witnesses.”
The LORD says, “I am God.”
passages.original: אָנֹכִ֞י הִגַּ֤דְתִּי וְהוֹשַׁ֙עְתִּי֙ וְהִשְׁמַ֔עְתִּי וְאֵ֥ין בָּכֶ֖ם זָ֑ר וְאַתֶּ֥ם עֵדַ֛י נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֖ה וַֽאֲנִי־ אֵֽל׃

passages.text: Even from eternity I am He, and none can deliver out of My hand. When I act, who can reverse it?”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He has always existed.
He existed from eternity.
No one can rescue from His hand.
When God acts, no one can reverse it.
passages.original: גַּם־ מִיּוֹם֙ אֲנִ֣י ה֔וּא וְאֵ֥ין מִיָּדִ֖י מַצִּ֑יל אֶפְעַ֖ל וּמִ֥י יְשִׁיבֶֽנָּה׃ס

passages.text: Thus says the LORD your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: “For your sake, I will send to Babylon and bring them all as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships in which they rejoice.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD is your Redeemer.
The LORD is the Holy One of Israel.
The LORD acts for your sake.
The LORD will send people to Babylon.
The LORD will bring them all down as fugitives.
The LORD will bring down the Chaldeans.
The Chaldeans rejoice in their ships.
The LORD will bring down the Chaldeans in those ships.
passages.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה גֹּאַלְכֶ֖ם קְד֣וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לְמַעַנְכֶ֞ם שִׁלַּ֣חְתִּי בָבֶ֗לָה וְהוֹרַדְתִּ֤י בָֽרִיחִים֙ כֻּלָּ֔ם וְכַשְׂדִּ֖ים בָּאֳנִיּ֥וֹת רִנָּתָֽם׃

passages.text: I am the LORD, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, and your King.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
He is your Holy One.
He created Israel.
He is your King.
passages.original: אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה קְדֽוֹשְׁכֶ֑ם בּוֹרֵ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מַלְכְּכֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: Thus says the LORD, who makes a way in the sea and a path through the surging waters, who brings out the chariots and horses, the armies and warriors together, to lie down, never to rise again; to be extinguished, snuffed out like a wick: “Do not call to mind the former things; pay no attention to the things of old.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD is powerful.
The LORD makes a way in the sea.
The LORD creates a path through strong waters.
The LORD brings out chariots and horses.
The LORD brings out armies and strong warriors together.
They all lie down.
They do not rise again.
They are extinguished.
They go out like a candle wick.
Do not remember the former things.
Do not pay attention to things of old.
passages.original: כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה הַנּוֹתֵ֥ן בַּיָּ֖ם דָּ֑רֶךְ וּבְמַ֥יִם עַזִּ֖ים נְתִיבָֽה׃ הַמּוֹצִ֥יא רֶֽכֶב־ וָס֖וּס חַ֣יִל וְעִזּ֑וּז יַחְדָּ֤ו יִשְׁכְּבוּ֙ בַּל־ יָק֔וּמוּ דָּעֲכ֖וּ כַּפִּשְׁתָּ֥ה כָבֽוּ׃ אַֽל־ תִּזְכְּר֖וּ רִֽאשֹׁנ֑וֹת וְקַדְמֹנִיּ֖וֹת אַל־ תִּתְבֹּנָֽנוּ׃

passages.text: Behold, I am about to do something new; even now it is coming. Do you not see it? Indeed, I will make a way in the wilderness and streams in the desert.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your Holy One.
The LORD is the Creator of Israel.
The LORD is your King.
The LORD says this:
I am about to do something new.
It is happening now.
Do you see it?
I will make a way in the wilderness.
I will make streams in the desert.
passages.original: הִנְנִ֨י עֹשֶׂ֤ה חֲדָשָׁה֙ עַתָּ֣ה תִצְמָ֔ח הֲל֖וֹא תֵֽדָע֑וּהָ אַ֣ף אָשִׂ֤ים בַּמִּדְבָּר֙ דֶּ֔רֶךְ בִּֽישִׁמ֖וֹן נְהָרֽוֹת׃

passages.text: The beasts of the field will honor Me, the jackals and the ostriches, because I provide water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert, to give drink to My chosen people.
passages.sermon:
God speaks in this passage.
God says that wild animals will honor Him.
The beasts of the field will honor God.
Jackals will honor God.
Ostriches will honor God.
God gives water in the wilderness.
God makes rivers in the desert.
God does this to give drink to His chosen people.
passages.original: תְּכַבְּדֵ֙נִי֙ חַיַּ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה תַּנִּ֖ים וּבְנ֣וֹת יַֽעֲנָ֑ה כִּֽי־ נָתַ֨תִּי בַמִּדְבָּ֜ר מַ֗יִם נְהָרוֹת֙ בִּֽישִׁימֹ֔ן לְהַשְׁק֖וֹת עַמִּ֥י בְחִירִֽי׃

passages.text: The people I formed for Myself will declare My praise.
passages.sermon:
God formed a people for Himself.
These people belong to God.
God made them for His own purpose.
These people will declare God's praise.
They will speak about God's greatness.
passages.original: עַם־ זוּ֙ יָצַ֣רְתִּי לִ֔י תְּהִלָּתִ֖י יְסַפֵּֽרוּ׃ס

passages.text: But you have not called on Me, O Jacob, because you have grown weary of Me, O Israel.
passages.sermon: God speaks to Jacob and Israel.\r\nGod says, "You have not called on Me, Jacob."\r\nGod says, "You have grown tired of Me, Israel."
passages.original: וְלֹא־ אֹתִ֥י קָרָ֖אתָ יַֽעֲקֹ֑ב כִּֽי־ יָגַ֥עְתָּ בִּ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: You have not brought Me sheep for burnt offerings, nor honored Me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with offerings, nor wearied you with frankincense.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Israel.
God says, “You have not brought Me sheep for burnt offerings.
You have not honored Me with your sacrifices.
I did not make you serve Me with grain offerings.
I did not make you tired with demands for frankincense.”
passages.original: לֹֽא־ הֵבֵ֤יאתָ לִּי֙ שֵׂ֣ה עֹלֹתֶ֔יךָ וּזְבָחֶ֖יךָ לֹ֣א כִבַּדְתָּ֑נִי לֹ֤א הֶעֱבַדְתִּ֙יךָ֙ בְּמִנְחָ֔ה וְלֹ֥א הוֹגַעְתִּ֖יךָ בִּלְבוֹנָֽה׃

passages.text: You have not bought Me sweet cane with your silver, nor satisfied Me with the fat of your sacrifices. But you have burdened Me with your sins; you have wearied Me with your iniquities.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Israel.
God says, "You have not bought Me sweet cane with your silver."
"You have not satisfied Me with the fat of your sacrifices."
"But you have burdened Me with your sins."
"You have wearied Me with your iniquities."
passages.original: לֹא־ קָנִ֨יתָ לִּ֤י בַכֶּ֙סֶף֙ קָנֶ֔ה וְחֵ֥לֶב זְבָחֶ֖יךָ לֹ֣א הִרְוִיתָ֑נִי אַ֗ךְ הֶעֱבַדְתַּ֙נִי֙ בְּחַטֹּאותֶ֔יךָ הוֹגַעְתַּ֖נִי בַּעֲוֺנֹתֶֽיךָ׃ס

passages.text: I, yes I, am He who blots out your transgressions for My own sake and remembers your sins no more.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people Israel.
God says, “I am the one who forgives your sins.
I blot out your transgressions for My own sake.
I do not remember your sins.”
passages.original: אָנֹכִ֨י אָנֹכִ֥י ה֛וּא מֹחֶ֥ה פְשָׁעֶ֖יךָ לְמַעֲנִ֑י וְחַטֹּאתֶ֖יךָ לֹ֥א אֶזְכֹּֽר׃

passages.text: Remind Me, let us argue the matter together. State your case, so that you may be vindicated.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people Israel.
God invites Israel to speak with Him.
God says, "Remind Me."
God says, "Let us argue the matter together."
God says, "State your case."
God says, "Do this so that you may be vindicated."
passages.original: הַזְכִּירֵ֕נִי נִשָּׁפְטָ֖ה יָ֑חַד סַפֵּ֥ר אַתָּ֖ה לְמַ֥עַן תִּצְדָּֽק׃

passages.text: Your first father sinned, and your spokesmen rebelled against Me.
passages.sermon:
Your first father sinned.
Your spokesmen rebelled against Me.
God speaks these words to Israel.
God identifies Israel’s ancestors and leaders as those who sinned and rebelled.
passages.original: אָבִ֥יךָ הָרִאשׁ֖וֹן חָטָ֑א וּמְלִיצֶ֖יךָ פָּ֥שְׁעוּ בִֽי׃

passages.text: So I will disgrace the princes of your sanctuary, and I will devote Jacob to destruction and Israel to reproach.”
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Israel.
God says, “I will disgrace the princes of your sanctuary.
I will hand over Jacob to destruction.
I will make Israel a subject of reproach.”
passages.original: וַאֲחַלֵּ֖ל שָׂ֣רֵי קֹ֑דֶשׁ וְאֶתְּנָ֤ה לַחֵ֙רֶם֙ יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְגִדּוּפִֽים׃ס
